d:
Thick, coarse mahogany brown fur covering the head and face. Calm, drooping olive green eyes. Apparent age is mature adulthood. A bulky, barrel-chested bovine build. Wears a traditional deep navy blue kimono with a wide gold obi sash. Features two large, curving ivory horns and a short, tufted mahogany brown tail.
BODY COLOR: mahogany brown
